title: Hidden-test grading leaves orphaned node --test processes behind
body:
Evidence 2026-11-16 19:00: six node --test processes (ages 18h-4d, parent pid 1075, cwd deleted under /mnt/storage/tmp/d23-regrade-n100/ and /mnt/storage/tmp/d23-clause-grade/) were left behind by hidden-test grading runs; killed by the lead.
Outcome: after a grading run that times out, 0 node --test child processes survive.
Proof: a regression test spawns a grade that times out and asserts the child count is 0.
Relevant to S7 screening (t-1p7dmw9), which runs many grades.
